description: Free quote for one verification run: the fixed 3-call plan for the target plus the constituent test-call cost summed from the target endpoint's own listed prices. An unknown or ineligible target is answered free, before payment. HTTP equivalent: POST /run/quote.

endpoint_path.description: Optional: the specific paid endpoint path to test.

service_id.description: The Layer 0 service id to test (see arena_eligible).
